statements.text: Reading a resource fails when its text is not JSON, nests deeper than 64 levels, or has more than 10000 json link matches. That fails its whole batch.
statements.notes: Partial live: the server's ExtractLinks (the json-link extractor a sync uses) refuses a body that is not JSON, a 70-level nesting under an extension link (WALKDEPTH 64) and 10,001 matches (WALKMATCHES 10000) with {'status':'error'}; 3 cases, 0 journal records. ReadResource's not-JSON refusal and the failure of the whole batch need a sync over a FHIR repository. Note: the depth bound applies only while an extension json link is configured (Walk runs only then, FHIRGraph.cls:2973-2975).

statements.text: Some namespaces lack the edge index that IRIS keeps. There, undoing inference is refused inside the caller's open transaction.
statements.notes: The refusal applies only where rdf_edges lacks the functional adjacency index. AUDITE, deployed by the pin's initialize_schema, has it (observation: Adjacency.IndexKind() = functional, engine._adjacency_indexed True), so the branch cannot be entered there; making a namespace without it would need a schema change outside the pin's deploy path. No dependency is missing; the code is read at the pin (refuse_in_caller_transaction raises CallerTransactionOpenError when $TLEVEL > 0, the same helper whose refusals hold live elsewhere, e.g. SNP-X2.2).
